body.statement: For every \(G\in\mathcal F\), the compact Laplace class is nonempty. In particular, assigning the value \(\beta\) to every on-graph coefficient gives \(\lVert B\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\le N\beta\le1/8\) and \(\sigma_{\min}(Q_{V\setminus S,V\setminus S})\ge7/8\) for every \(S\in\mathcal I\); any interior scale choice is admissible, and \(\mathbb E|\varepsilon_i|^4\le24s_+^4\).
body.justification: Nonemptiness and a uniform fourth-moment envelope prevent the inferential class from being an assumption-driven empty shell.
body.gap: The compact subclass is introduced here for certified full-law inference; the stated construction verifies it without imposing stability on the population identification class.
body.consumer: The confidence-superset theorem has a concrete mechanism for every candidate graph and uniform moment control for diagnostic extensions.
